scenes.text: Have you ever looked at the massive, dry Sahara Desert on a map and wondered if it’s always been this incredibly hot, empty, and lifeless?
Just five thousand years ago, this giant dust bowl was actually a lush, green paradise filled with deep lakes, flowing rivers, and roaming hippos.
Every twenty thousand years, the Earth wobbles slightly on its axis, completely shifting the global monsoon rains and transforming the entire desert back into a thriving jungle.

With this green cycle absolutely guaranteed to happen again, do you think humans will survive to see this massive barren wasteland turn back into a beautiful tropical rainforest, or is our climate changing too fast? Drop your thoughts in the comments below and hit that follow button for more insane Earth secrets!
